name: Old Brock
text: At the bell, your units next to this with no quarry take the enemy across from this as quarry and can reach it anywhere. Units next to this have Pounce and +1 Attack.
golden_text: At the bell, your units next to this with no quarry take the enemy across from this as quarry and can reach it anywhere. Units next to this have Pounce and +2 Attack.
